objective: Shortest evidence-backed path from one scoped change to one Samsung candidate
stages: resolve exact source and current service capabilities
run exact-source CI when build inputs change
hash artifact, copy durable binary to Google Drive, and inspect pointer receipt
save proposed seal with unresolved gates

ci.artifactAuthority: exact tested source plus run and digests

mesh.modelSelection: target-account verified access plus task eval and budget; no inferred API entitlement
mesh.deploymentStatus: policy only; no hosted Lum or Oni deployment asserted

providerResponsibilities.GitHub: canonical source database, review, CI, receipts, hashes and artifact pointers; release/CI binaries are transient transport/cache only
providerResponsibilities.GoogleDrive: durable LuHm file server for APKs, ZIPs, media, manuals, snapshots, recovery bundles and large build artifacts
providerResponsibilities.FastAPICloud: identified authenticated backend only when needed
providerResponsibilities.Modal: bounded measured compute job only when needed
providerResponsibilities.HuggingFace: discovery or bounded evaluation when entitled
providerResponsibilities.Pets: ChatGPT companion presentation; never backend inference
providerResponsibilities.OpenAI: semantic state and agent context pointers only; not canonical source or binary storage

enterpriseAcceptance: enforced repository review and release protection
secrets isolated from untrusted PRs and clients
privateAudit: Account, pet and private Drive evidence kept in the installed personal skill; not published here
